jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(E) inventory: Rockingham School District, a town school district in the Windham Northeast Supervisory Union (member town: Rockingham). Operates PK-8; grades 9-12 attend the Bellows Falls Union High School District.

board.post_note: Rockingham SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected at the floor-vote annual meeting.

sources.note: Rockingham SD signed 2026 warning (official; approved Jan. 5, 2026): the signature block publishes the five directors with term years -- Deschenes-Desmond 2027, Kibbe 2028, Holloway 2027, DeMasi 2026, Contee 2026. The extraction of the warning skips the director-election article (Art. 4). The board's organization minutes of March 9, 2026 (WNESU HighBond portal) record the board seated after the Feb. 28, 2026 annual meeting: Deschenes-Desmond Chair, Contee Vice Chair, DeMasi Board Clerk, with Kibbe and Holloway. FLAG: DeMasi's and Contee's warning term years expired at the Feb. 28, 2026 meeting and no fetched document records their re-election -- they are minted off the post-election roster with NO ends (the Derby/Fletcher pattern); the resolving document is the Feb. 28, 2026 annual meeting minutes. Board size five rests on the uniform five-director record (the section 423(b) expansion vote was not fetched).
